title: Fix DCE/RPC Decode As so it no longer crashes
description:
DCE/RPC Decode As can only work if there is a DCE/RPC packet available to populate the decode_dcerpc_bind_values_t structure that Decode As needs.  Add a few NULL checks to prevent crashes if Decode As for DCE/RPC is used in other situations (like not having a capture file loaded).

Fix the disconnect between when guid_key values and decode_dcerpc_bind_values_t data need to be used to prevent further crashes discovered after the NULL checks were added.

Fixes #20844

Fix DCE/RPC Decode As so it no longer crashes

DCE/RPC Decode As can only work if there is a DCE/RPC packet available to populate the decode_dcerpc_bind_values_t structure that Decode As needs.  Add a few NULL checks to prevent crashes if Decode As for DCE/RPC is used in other situations (like not having a capture file loaded).

Fix the disconnect between when guid_key values and decode_dcerpc_bind_values_t data need to be used to prevent further crashes discovered after the NULL checks were added.

Fixes #20844
